column1: # Optimistic transaction rerun audit on rust-engine/multiuser, base 59141461ed7c3508c7af0cb20009212f5ba50934 (line numbers are base lines).

# runOptimisticTransaction (src/core/rust-engine/optimistic-transaction.ts) runs an engine.transaction callback again after write_conflict; this lists what each callback does outside the transaction on a rerun.
# Each callback answers two questions: does the body touch the filesystem, and does it read or set a flag or variable declared outside the callback that an earlier run already changed.

# Section 1, every engine.transaction call in src/: 474 rows = 415 audited in this lane + 59 out of lane (46 L1, 13 src/shadow/ L2). Verdicts: FIXED 9, FOLLOW-UP 59, SAFE 48, UNREACHABLE 132, pure 226

# Section 2, via a pass-through wrapper (not counted in section 1): 335 rows, one per caller that passes its function through a wrapper. Verdicts: FIXED 16, FOLLOW-UP 1, SAFE 69, UNREACHABLE 10, pure 239
